title: Dataset Lineage Validator
description: Validates declared data lineage edges for missing nodes, duplicate edges, self-links, and cycles.
decision: A lineage graph passes when every edge references declared nodes and the directed graph is acyclic.
inputs: The caller supplies unique node identifiers and directed source-to-target edges.
limitations: This checks structural lineage declarations only. It cannot verify that transformations actually ran or that source data is accurate.

input_schema.description: The caller supplies unique node identifiers and directed source-to-target edges.
